title: International Labour Organization
definition: The International Labour Organization (ILO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations mandated to advance social and economic justice by setting international labour standards.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding UN specialized agencies, core conventions, and India's ratification status. In Mains (GS Paper II/III), it is crucial for questions on labour reforms, informal economy, social security, and international governance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of International Labour Organization.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of International Relations and Indian Labour Economics
